name: Digital Mold
description: Gray-Scott mycelium with nutrient-gradient chemotaxis — hyphae extend up the image-luminance gradient the way real mycelium forages, rather than diffusing isotropically — and per-band sporulation regimes, where each FFT bin pushes its own zone into a different region of the Gray-Scott parameter plane so the colony grows visibly different structures per frequency. Also replaces a per-frame spore hash that strobed with a coherent drifting field, and derives alpha from colony density instead of passing the source alpha through.
